f020.scope: For every odd prime p and s>=2, actual P_(2p) irreducible over Q_p(q), P_(2p) and H_(2p) squarefree, explicit separating residual, exact root distances, discriminant valuation and bilinear kernel nonisotropy.
f020.accepted_range: 0<=b<p^s and b<=2p, p odd prime, s>=1
f020.separating_residual: P_(2p)(a+tZ)/(2 kappa t^p) reduces to Z^p+cZ, c=(-1)^((p+1)/2)
f020.root_distances: Within either p-root cluster v=1; between clusters v=(2p-1)/(2p), v(q-1)=1
f020.local_all_A_composition: Only on the new accepted static-guard range where the inherited theorem’s other accepted guards hold; original signed coefficients and normalization unchanged.

sparse.scope: Uniform prime-power binary Fourier equality-mask classification, with scope qualification preserving previously accepted exact cases and quantitative no-mask bounds.
sparse.proper_degree_optimization: Delta_(p^a,p^a-d)=sqrt(d/p^a) iff d=p^b, 0<=b<a; all other proper d have a strict gap.
sparse.proof: Weighted character-filtration descent with both Grams, repeated labels, unequal row weights, exact p-point unitary transforms, proved square blocks and nonnegative order-one base.
sparse.scope_qualification: Do not accept the candidate’s blanket all-optima/all-quantitative-gaps-open sentence. Preserve Delta(3,1)=sqrt(3)/2, codimension-two/three classifications, and existing general and polynomial quantitative bounds. Only remaining exact optima and sharper/optimal gap rates remain open.
sparse.inherited_quantitative_corollary: For newly excluded proper prime-power d, the accepted general no-mask bound applies: Delta_(N,N-d)^2 >= d/N + 1/[10 N d^(phi(N)-1)]. This is an inherited formula, not a newly proved quantitative bound.
